recipe.visualDefinition: A vibrant, multi-layered collage featuring a central DJ at a turntable, flanked by two dancing women, set against a surreal airbrushed sky with rainbows and stylized 3D graffiti-inspired typography.
coreVisualRelationships: DJ as the grounded central anchor in the lower foreground
Dancers framing the composition on the left and right mid-ground
Floating 3D logo and text elements occupying the upper central void
Surreal sky and rainbow background providing a unified atmospheric backdrop

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: DJ is large and centered at the bottom; dancers are medium-scale on the sides; logo is large and centered at the top.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The DJ's hands on the turntable at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Circular movement from the DJ up to the dancers, peaking at the central logo, and back down through the rainbows.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures, text, and atmospheric clouds.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Sky blue and cloud white for the background environment.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Deep black and navy blue for the subjects' clothing.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant red, yellow, and rainbow spectrum for graphic elements.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the graphics against a softer, pastel-toned background.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Geometric sans-serif and graffiti-style block letters.
letterConstructionRules: Top banner uses heavy, wide, rounded sans-serif
Main logo uses interlocking 3D block letters with heavy outlines
Secondary text uses clean, bold, all-caps sans-serif
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters in the main logo are skewed and layered to create a sense of depth and motion
Numerical digits are rendered as metallic 3D objects
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Heavy display graffiti paired with clean, geometric sans-serif for legibility.
graphicDevices: Horizontal red banner at the top

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the weight and clarity of the secondary text.
Necessary for the main title's interlocking 3D style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a digital collage featuring a DJ in a navy jacket and black beanie at a turntable in the lower center. Place two women in black crop tops dancing on either side. The background should be a surreal airbrushed sky with fluffy white clouds and vibrant rainbows. Include a solid red bar at the very top.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large 3D interlocking graffiti-style logo in the upper center. Below it, add a line of bold, white, all-caps sans-serif text. On the top red bar, add wide, bold, white sans-serif text.

verificationChecks: Is the DJ the central foreground focus?
Are the rainbows and clouds airbrushed in style?
Is the main logo 3D and interlocking?
Is the top red banner present and populated with text?

mustRedesign: Exact facial features of the subjects
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the 3D text has consistent perspective
Verify the red banner is perfectly horizontal
Confirm the DJ's hands are visible on the equipment
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a central photographic subject with flanking dancers against an airbrushed sky, topped with a solid color banner and centered 3D display typography.
